run_object_detection_inference: run object detection inference on an image using a DETR model on Intel Gaudi HPU
run_object_detection_with_hpu_graphs: run object detection inference with HPU graphs enabled for lower latency on Gaudi
run_object_detection_bf16: run object detection inference with bfloat16 precision enabled on Intel Gaudi HPU
benchmark_object_detection_latency: benchmark object detection inference latency with warmup and timed iterations on Gaudi HPU
print_object_detection_results: run object detection and print detected objects with confidence scores and bounding boxes
